{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during uptrends by ~0.3-0.5 on average",
    "Model overestimates lows in bear markets, lagging price bottoms by 1-2 days",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.67) aligns better with model forecasts, negative requires 0.3+ adjustment downward",
    "Mean reversion bias: model lacks speed, prices move farther than model predicts from historical means",
    "When sentiment flips from positive to negative, adjust forecasts 0.2-0.4 below model for first 5-10 days",
    "Volatility expansion periods break standard sentiment-correlation; use 70% of model confidence for first 15 days of forecast horizon",
    "Prices below 72 show stronger mean reversion to 70-71 than model predicts, add 0.3 upward bias for t < 72" ] }
